findings.summary: P0-05 unification writes a FakeCampaign fixture id (e.g. 'cmp_fx_001') as the shared activeCampaignId · PublishModule then calls campaignsApi.getBySlug('cmp_fx_001') which 404s at the real HTTP endpoint /campaigns/{slug} · publish mint fails with 'Campaign "cmp_fx_001" not found'.
findings.evidence: CampaignsSection.tsx:36 setActiveCampaignId(selected ? selected.id : null) · selected is FakeCampaign whose id shape is 'cmp_fx_00N' with NO slug field (fixtures/fakeCampaigns.ts:3-21). Campaigns.tsx by contrast writes featured.slug + c.slug (real Campaign.slug). PublishModule.tsx:288-297 reads getModeState().activeCampaignId then calls campaignsApi.getBySlug(activeCampaignId). Sidecar-stub tolerates both (line 2943 `x.slug === slug || x.id === slug`) BUT the real HTTP path bridgeToBackend GET /campaigns/{slug} (sidecar-stub.ts:2929-2942) hits FastAPI /campaigns/{slug} which only resolves by slug. Live trigger path: user opens #/campaign → picks campaign → clicks 'Review · N submissions' (CampaignsSection.tsx:143) → navigateTo(SECTION_EDITOR, {campaignId: selected.id}) writes 'cmp_fx_001' to URL → EditorSection.tsx:135-138 mirrors that into mode-store → Publish reads it → HTTP 404 → 'campaign_not_found' toast + mint failure.
findings.reproduce: grep -n 'setActiveCampaignId(selected' desktop-2/src/sections/campaigns/CampaignsSection.tsx && grep -n 'setActiveCampaignId(featured.slug\|setActiveCampaignId(c.slug' desktop-2/src/design-os/routes/Campaigns.tsx && grep -n 'find((x) => x.slug === slug' desktop-2/src/design-os/engine/sidecar-stub.ts && grep -n 'GET "/campaigns/"\|campaigns/{slug}' junior-backend/app/routes/campaigns.py
findings.suggested_fix: Normalise the id shape at every write site. Options: (a) give FakeCampaign a slug field derived from name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-') and write selected.slug like Campaigns.tsx does; (b) branch in setActiveCampaignId's consumers to try slug-first-then-id (but that duplicates the mock stub's tolerance across a network boundary); (c) delete CampaignsSection's fixture id path entirely and route users through the real Campaigns.tsx route only. The stated fix goal ('publish + campaign-watermark composite resolve the same campaign') is defeated the moment the legacy section writes a fixture id.

findings.summary: getModeState().activeCampaignId is read as a snapshot inside EditorBody · does NOT subscribe · if the user changes the active campaign in another surface while EditorBody is already mounted, the campaignId prop stays stale until a full remount.
findings.evidence: Line 129 `const campaignId = paramCampaignId ?? getModeState().activeCampaignId;` reads state imperatively at render time. modeStore.ts exports useUserMode() as the subscribe-aware hook (line 59-78) but EditorBody uses the snapshot getter. PublishModule reads getModeState() at publish-time (fine), but any UI branch in EditorBody that depends on campaignId (e.g. campaign chip render, watermark preview) will show stale data across a sibling mode-store write.
findings.suggested_fix: Either use useUserMode() and read state.activeCampaignId (subscribes), or accept the snapshot semantics and document that campaign changes require a route reload. Given the P0-05 fix explicitly wants 'both editors + PublishModule read the same source of truth', a subscribing read is the more honest choice.

dispositions.summary: The direct useEffect write from CampaignsSection to mode-store is gone (verified). BUT the untouched leak at CampaignsSection.tsx:141 (navigateTo(SECTION_EDITOR, { campaignId: selected.id })) routes the fixture id 'cmp_fx_00N' through the URL param, and EditorSection.tsx:138-142 explicitly writes that URL param into mode-store via setActiveCampaignId. PublishModule.tsx:288 then reads getModeState().activeCampaignId + calls campaignsApi.getBySlug('cmp_fx_001').
dispositions.evidence: CampaignsSection.tsx:141 · onClick={() => navigateTo(SECTION_IDS.SECTION_EDITOR, { campaignId: selected.id })} · selected.id is `cmp_fx_${n}` per createCampaign() line 42. EditorSection.tsx:138-142 · useEffect(() => { if (paramCampaignId && getModeState().activeCampaignId !== paramCampaignId) setActiveCampaignId(paramCampaignId) }, [paramCampaignId]). PublishModule.tsx:288-297 · const activeCampaignId = getModeState().activeCampaignId · await campaignsApi.getBySlug(activeCampaignId). sidecar-stub.ts:2929-2942 · real-http path GETs /campaigns/{slug} which junior-backend/app/routes/campaigns.py has NO handler for (only /campaigns list, /admin/campaigns/{slug} patch/delete, /agency/campaigns/{slug} get — public GET-by-slug is absent). Mock fallback searches campaignsState.campaigns which starts empty in real-user flow.
dispositions.user-facing outcome: Non-silent · PublishModule emits toast { kind: 'warning', title: 'Publish tracked (partial)', body: 'Campaign "cmp_fx_001" not found · earning not registered.' } and throws 'campaign_not_found' (PublishModule.tsx:383-389). Export still lands; mint is skipped explicitly. Failure mode is honest, bounded, and downgrades to P1 because it is loud + fail-closed rather than silent + data-losing.
dispositions.why-P1-not-P0: P0-001 as originally written specified 'silent empty render / silent success lie / data loss / broken core flow'. The current path is NONE of those — it surfaces a titled warning toast + short-circuits the mint. Daniel's fix comment at CampaignsSection.tsx:35-38 explicitly documents this expected-behaviour ('PublishModule falls through to its no active campaign branch when reached from this preview surface'). The design intent is stated + honoured. Remaining risk is confusion: user sees 'cmp_fx_001' in an error toast + doesn't recognise it as a fixture id. That's a P2 copy polish (add 'This preview campaign hasn't been saved to your account yet · create it from the Campaigns route to earn.'), not a shipper-blocking P0.
dispositions.suggested_fix: P2 follow-up: recognize the `cmp_fx_*` prefix in EditorSection.tsx:138-142 guard and DON'T write it to mode-store (leave activeCampaignId null so Publish's cleaner 'No campaign linked' path at PublishModule.tsx:366-372 fires instead). Copy at PublishModule.tsx:387 could also detect the prefix and swap in preview-language. Neither blocks ship.

dispositions.summary: useUserMode subscribes to setActiveCampaignId writes via subscribeMode (modeStore.ts:67-74) → setActiveCampaignId → emit() → listener → setState. Verified no infinite loop: the useEffect at EditorSection.tsx:138 fires only on paramCampaignId change (URL-driven, NOT mode-store-driven), and its write is guarded by `getModeState().activeCampaignId !== paramCampaignId` so the second render loop is a no-op.
dispositions.evidence: modeStore.ts:59-78 exports useUserMode with useEffect that calls subscribeMode(handle) where handle = () => setState(getModeState()). setActiveCampaignId at line 48-51 calls emit() which fires every listener. EditorSection.tsx dependency array on line 142 is [paramCampaignId] — mode.activeCampaignId subscription changes do NOT retrigger that effect. The imperative getModeState() READ inside the effect is a one-shot check-and-write, not a subscription source. Loop analysis: (a) URL changes → paramCampaignId changes → effect runs → setActiveCampaignId(new) → emit() → useUserMode setState → EditorBody re-renders with mode.activeCampaignId=new · effect dep array unchanged · no re-fire. (b) Sibling sets activeCampaignId → emit() → useUserMode setState → EditorBody re-renders · paramCampaignId unchanged · effect dep array unchanged · no re-fire. Clean.

dispositions.summary: void setPretending line gone. setPretending remains genuinely used at ExportPanel.tsx:88 (useEvent 'engine:progress' handler) so the state hook is alive. tsc green.
